name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror And Transparent Acrylic Stand Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of Transparent Acrylic and Mirror Acrylic, creating an elegant dimensional tabletop sign with a premium reflective finish.
          +) Layer 1: Transparent Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing.
          +) Layer 2: Mirror Acrylic 3mm with engraving or custom cutout.
          +) Base: Mirror Acrylic 3mm with engraving or custom cutout.
    - The transparent acrylic panel provides a clean and modern background for personalized text and artwork.
    - Mirror acrylic decorative elements add depth, contrast, and an eye-catching reflective accent to the design.
    - Mirror Acrylic is available in:
          +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
          +) Silver Mirror Acrylic
    - The matching mirror acrylic base securely supports the sign for stable tabletop display. 
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Sign size options:
          +) 5 x 7 in ~ 12.7 x 17.78 cm
          +) 7 x 7 in ~ 17.78 x 17.78 cm
    - Corresponding base sizes:
          +) 5 x 3.5 in ~ 12.7 x 8.89 cm
          +) 7 x 3.5 in ~ 17.78 x 8.89 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - The Transparent Acrylic layer features high-quality 1-sided UV printing for personalized names, table numbers, dates, messages, and decorative artwork.
    - The Mirror Acrylic layer supports precision laser engraving and custom laser cutting for raised decorative lettering, numbers, symbols, and custom-shaped elements.
    - The Mirror Acrylic base can also feature laser engraving or cutout details for additional personalization.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a freestanding tabletop sign for weddings, receptions, engagement parties, anniversaries, birthdays, corporate events, restaurants, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for use as a table number sign, reserved table sign, name sign, welcome sign, seating display, event information sign, or decorative tabletop accent.
    - Suitable for personalization with names, table numbers, dates, monograms, messages, symbols, and themed decorative elements.
    - The slot-in base construction keeps the sign upright and allows for convenient tabletop display without additional supports.
    - Mirror acrylic elements enhance important details such as numbers, names, or decorative accents.
    - Durable and reusable construction makes the sign suitable for both event display and keepsake use.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A stylish personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, event hosts, family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, bridal showers, birthdays, housewarmings, and milestone celebrations.
    - Great for creating coordinated personalized signage for wedding tables, receptions, parties, and special events.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake featuring meaningful names, dates, table numbers, or personalized messages.
    - A sophisticated decorative piece combining clear transparent acrylic with Gold or Silver Mirror Acrylic details for an elegant and premium presentation.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror And Transparent Acrylic Stand Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
